question: Is the automation owner comfortable landing this external-merge preflight comment-evidence policy once the draft is ready?
rationale: The patch changes when top-level PR comments stop blocking guarded merge automation, and that risk tolerance is a maintainer-owned policy choice even though the code review found no concrete defect.

options.title: Land after automation-owner review
options.body: Merge after confirming the exact-head ready-review, author-status, Dependency Guard, and pagination rules match the intended external-preflight policy.

options.title: Require live preflight proof
options.body: Ask for an artifact-backed dry run on a representative PR before merging if maintainers want stronger evidence beyond the focused fixtures and CI.

options.title: Keep draft paused
options.body: Leave this PR open and draft until the automation policy is settled or the branch is narrowed further.

recommendation.title: Land after automation-owner review
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the exact-head ready-review, author-status, Dependency Guard, and pagination rules match the intended external-preflight policy.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced and recently maintained the external merge preflight path touched by this PR.
